reason: Freeze the sampling-aware qualification, technical selection, response-space, and entrant rules for the independent-context audit before computing any revised independent-context model score.

affected_decisions.rationale: Preserves the candidate order frozen in revision_analysis_registry_v1 and resolves Replogle_K562 to the essential-scale dataset because its legacy raw bridge passed the effect-size gate whereas the GWPS day-8 bridge did not.

affected_decisions.value: normal-approximation expectation under a matched-size without-replacement control null: sqrt(2/pi) * mean_g(sd_control,g) * sqrt(N_control / (n_target * (N_control - n_target)))
affected_decisions.rationale: This is the closed-form expectation of the same target-versus-complement control null used in M1 and avoids running a separate 1,000-replicate control bootstrap for hundreds of distinct cell counts.

affected_decisions.value: recompute control variances from the two HCC raw objects and compare the closed-form expectation with the frozen M1 Monte Carlo target-level null; require median relative error <=0.01, maximum relative error <=0.05, and Pearson correlation >=0.999 before external qualification
affected_decisions.rationale: Validates the computational optimization against the already frozen empirical estimator without using independent-context model scores.
Adds the effect-size threshold requested by Reviewer 3 to the sampling-aware qualification.

affected_decisions.value: select the first candidate in frozen order that passes the corrected gate, has stable controls/identifiers, and supports all three frozen real entrants; stop selection before any independent-context model score is computed
affected_decisions.rationale: Prevents cherry-picking by downstream audit performance.
All are existing WTShiftBench entrant definitions that can be applied as target-held-out/leave-one-target-out predictions; they require no scored-target expression vector as predictor.

affected_decisions.value: top 1024 unique HGNC-symbol genes by variance of log1p(total-count-normalized) expression among controls in the selected context; ties resolved by gene symbol
affected_decisions.rationale: Defines a model- and endpoint-score-blind response space that keeps the full audit computationally tractable while retaining broad observed response geometry.

affected_decisions.value: freeze endpoint categories on all eligible DepMap-matched targets; model scoring uses their common mappable intersection across all formal entrants without recomputing percentiles or categories
affected_decisions.rationale: Separates endpoint-object construction from model-specific coverage in the same way as the HCC SS18L2 rule.

results_status_at_amendment: Legacy raw bridge results for all candidates and the HCC closed-form-versus-Monte-Carlo validation were available. No sampling-corrected independent-context bridge or independent-context model score had been computed.
selection_statement: The candidate order, corrected gate, response-space rule, and entrant identities are fixed without independent-context model performance.
